memberdef.name: XNandPs_Write

briefdescription.para: Programs the flash device with data from the user buffer.

detaileddescription.para: The source and destination addresses must be aligned to the width of the flash data bus. This function does not check for bad blocks while writing flash pages that cross a block boundary. The caller must handle bad blocks.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the XNandPs instance.
Flash data address to write to.
Number of bytes to write.
Source address to write the data from.
User buffer that holds data to write into the spare data area.

listitem.para: XST_NAND_WRITE_PROTECTED if the flash is write protected.

simplesect.para: Writes a number of sequential pages into the flash device.
